notablePrerequisites:
Wirewood Channeler does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five Elves.
description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Pestermite to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Pestermite by paying {2}{U}.
When Pestermite enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat.
If you control six or more Elves, this combo nets infinite mana.
